headline: Cardiovascular safety of orforglipron versus insulin glargine in adults with type 2 diabetes at increased cardiovascular risk (ACHIEVE-4): a phase 3, event-driven, randomised, open-label, non-inferiority, active comparator trial.

The Phase 3, randomised, open-label trial assigned 2,749 participants and followed them for a median of two years.

Orforglipron met the prespecified non-inferiority test for a composite of cardiovascular death, non-fatal heart attack, non-fatal stroke or hospitalisation for unstable angina. The hazard ratio was 0.84 (95% confidence interval 0.59–1.20). This does not demonstrate cardiovascular superiority.

Gastrointestinal adverse events were more common with orforglipron; clinically significant or severe hypoglycaemia was less common. The study was funded by Lilly.
